columns.name: Program ID
columns.description: A unique ID for the program.

columns.name: Program Name
columns.description: The name of the program. Note that what are technically different programs can have the same name so Program ID is the more reliable way of matching programs.

columns.name: Description
columns.description: Additional details about a program

columns.name: Org Name
columns.description: Name of the host organization

columns.name: Category Name
columns.description: Denotes the "type" of program based on interest

columns.name: Capacity
columns.description: The maximum number of attendees

columns.name: Min Age
columns.description: The minimum age to participate

columns.name: Max Age
columns.description: The maximum age to participate

columns.name: Program URL
columns.description: The web address to find out more information

columns.name: Online Address
columns.description: A secondary web address to provide the user with additional information

columns.name: Registration URL
columns.description: The web address to access registration forms and applications

columns.name: Registration Open
columns.description: The date registration is available

columns.name: Registration Deadline
columns.description: The date registration is closed

columns.name: Start Date
columns.description: The beginning date of a program

columns.name: End Date
columns.description: The end date of a program

columns.name: Geographic Cluster Name
columns.description: The community name

columns.name: Meeting Type
columns.description: Denotes whether a program is in-person or virtual

columns.name: Image
columns.description: Provides a program image link

columns.name: Hidden Programs
columns.description: Denotes whether a program is hidden on the MCMF platform. Hidden programs must remain invisible on any maps, visualizations, and mobile apps.

columns.name: Featured
columns.description: Denotes whether the program is a featured program.

columns.name: Custom Categories
columns.description: Additional program labels, specifically for the My CHI. My Future. app (available in the Google and Apple app stores). Multiple categories are separated by the | character.

columns.name: Latitude
columns.description: The program location latitude.

columns.name: Longitude
columns.description: The program location longitude.

columns.name: Location
columns.description: The program location in a form that allows for mapping and other geographic analysis on this data portal.

columns.name: Community Areas
columns.description: This column was automatically created in order to record in what polygon from the dataset 'Community Areas' (vrxf-vc4k) the point in column 'locations' is located.  This enables the creation of region maps (choropleths) in the visualization canvas and data lens.

columns.name: Zip Codes
